g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE WITNESS · a sampled tree can differ from the true MST and still filter safely
All edges are drawn. Important edges carry their distinct weights; other chord weights are 11–28. Vertex positions are illustrative.
An edge is removed only when its sampled-forest path has a strictly smaller maximum weight. Every original MST edge survives.
This is a chosen eight-vertex sample, not a timing input, typical random draw or performance prediction. Counts and round traces are independently checked.
